scope: Only the eight named closed packets and explicit members of their nine manifests. Historical failures/aborted results preserved byte-for-byte; no reinterpretation.
retrieval: Use CANONICAL_REFERENCE_MAP canonical_path; verify SHA/bytes. Its alias indexes resolve to INPUT_MAP original paths and exact source-manifest hashes. V5 mappings remain unchanged.
atomicity: New same-directory exclusive temporary copy, fsync, chmod 0444, renamex_np RENAME_EXCL, canonical hash/size readback; matching existing objects rehashed once for this increment and not recopied. No overwrite.
preserved: All originals, checkpoint files and earlier archive records retained; no deletion, source edits, Git mutations, builds/tests/browser/native/server actions.
exclusions: maintained source referenced by source-binding reports
limitations: References within preserved reports do not imply their current external targets were archived. This increment covers explicit manifest members, including nested raw members already enumerated; no directory-wide inclusion. Historical preservation only, not final tranche qualification/acceptance or WORM storage.
